definition: Gundam Build Metaverse (Japanese: ガンダムビルドメタバース, Hepburn: Gandamu Birudo Metabāzu) is a Japanese original net animation anime mini-series produced by Sunrise Beyond, and the fifth series within the Gundam Build Series sub-series.
details: The series celebrates the 10th anniversary of the Gundam Build franchise, including characters from the previous installments.

explainer.lead: Gundam Build Metaverse is a Japanese anime mini-series released as an original net animation. Produced by Sunrise Beyond, it marks the Gundam Build franchise's 10th anniversary and brings back characters from earlier installments.

tiers.eli5: Think of it like a small anniversary party for a favorite series, with familiar characters from earlier stories invited along. It is the fifth Gundam Build series and was made for online viewing rather than being a game or computer program.
tiers.practitioner: This is an animated mini-series, not an AI model, software library, or deployable metaverse platform. Its practical context is media production: Sunrise Beyond created it as an original net animation for the Gundam Build franchise's 10th anniversary.
tiers.paperLevel: Gundam Build Metaverse = Japanese original net animation mini-series produced by Sunrise Beyond, and series 5 in the Gundam Build Series. Its stated scope is a 10th-anniversary celebration featuring characters from previous installments; no technical metaverse architecture or algorithm is defined by the title.

explainer.example: A viewer who followed earlier Gundam Build installments can watch this mini-series as a 10th-anniversary follow-up and encounter characters from those previous stories.

usedIn.name: Gundam Build Series
usedIn.detail: It is the fifth series within this sub-series.

usedIn.name: Gundam Build franchise
usedIn.detail: It celebrates the franchise's 10th anniversary with returning characters.

explainer.intuition: The series works as both a new mini-series and an anniversary reunion, using its place in the Gundam Build line to connect with earlier installments.
howItWorks: Sunrise Beyond produces the story as a Japanese original net animation mini-series.
It takes the fifth position within the Gundam Build Series sub-series.
Its anniversary role connects it to the wider Gundam Build franchise.
Characters from previous installments appear as part of that celebration.
explainer.whyItMatters: It marks a decade of the Gundam Build franchise and links its fifth sub-series entry to characters from earlier installments.
misconceptions: It is an anime mini-series, not an AI system or metaverse software platform.
It is the fifth Gundam Build series, not the first.
Its title does not by itself describe a technical implementation of a metaverse.

diagram.caption: The mini-series connects Sunrise Beyond's production, its place in the Gundam Build Series, and the franchise's anniversary celebration.
